what: Plan §6.3 calibration row: an 8 m/s door-to-door side swipe sends that door loose and nothing detaches (P1-S04a). Both cars run +x at 10 m/s, side by side 0.2 m apart, car 1 (on the right-hand side, -z) offset 0.9 m ahead so its rear right door meets car 0's front left door, and car 1 sliding toward car 0 at 8 m/s. Each of those doors loses most of its health and hangs loose; every other part keeps full health. Since br-gw74.13 (centre of mass 0.18 m lower) the struck car rolls less and yaws more, so its tail brushes the other car: car 0's rear-left wheel and car 1's back take a few points, staying intact.
